options.systemPromptTemplate: You extract purchase-order fields from the provided document text. CRITICAL: Never guess, invent, or assume any value. If a field is not clearly present in the text, return an empty string "" (or null) for it. Do not normalise, correct, or complete SKUs, quantities, prices, IDs or addresses — copy them exactly as written. Do not fabricate SKUs or customer IDs.

parameters.subject: =Order Confirmation - PO {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.po_number }}
parameters.message:
=

Dear {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.customer_name }},

We have received and processed your purchase order {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.po_number }}.

  • SKU: {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.sku }}
  • Quantity: {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.quantity }}
  • Delivery address: {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.delivery_address }}
  • Requested delivery date: {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.requested_delivery_date }}

Your order has been created and is being processed.

parameters.subject: =[Human Review] PO {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.po_number }} needs attention
parameters.message:
=

A purchase order was stopped before processing and needs human review.

  • PO number: {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.po_number }}
  • Customer: {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.customer_name }} ({{ $('Validate Order').item.json.customer_id }})
  • SKU: {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.sku }}
  • Quantity: {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.quantity }}
  • From: {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.source_email_from }}

Reason(s): {{ $('Validate Order').item.json.reason_text }}

nodes.name: Setup: Run Once to Seed Sheet

nodeGroups.name: Ingest & Extract
nodeGroups.description: Receive the PO email, read the attached PDF, and extract structured order fields with AI (never guessing).

nodeGroups.name: Reference Data Lookups
nodeGroups.description: Load the Customers, Products and Orders sheets used for deterministic validation.

nodeGroups.name: Validate & Route
nodeGroups.description: Deterministic code validation of every field; routes to order creation only when all checks pass.

nodeGroups.name: Create Order
nodeGroups.description: Create the order, send the customer confirmation, and write the audit log.

nodeGroups.name: Human Review
nodeGroups.description: Open a human-review case with the exact reason, notify a reviewer, and write the audit log.
